On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

**Calculating grid transformations**

I'm focused on a task that has specific rules for manipulating memory grids. The goal is to take a 3x3 input and generate a 6x6 output, divided into four orientations: upper left is original, upper right is clockwise, lower left is counterclockwise, and lower right is a 180-degree rotation. I need to make sure I calculate this correctly using the required math and code execution to transform the grid accordingly. Time to execute that!

steps.name: execute_code
steps.input:
g=[[6,1,0],[4,8,9],[2,7,3]]
# rotate 90 clockwise: transpose reversed rows
cw=[list(row) for row in zip(*g[::-1])]
ccw=[list(row) for row in zip(*g)][::-1]
rot180=[row[::-1] for row in g[::-1]]
out=[g[i]+cw[i] for i in range(3)]+[ccw[i]+rot180[i] for i in range(3)]
print(out)
